# Doorear
> Logistics marketplace and logistics operating system (LOS) for Indian supply chains.

Doorear connects manufacturers, eCommerce companies, distributors, courier companies, transporters, and 3PL providers on one unified B2B platform. It is operator workspace software—not a consumer parcel tracking app like Shiprocket.

## Canonical URLs
- Website: https://doorear.com
- Product app: https://app.doorear.com
- Contact / demo: https://doorear.com/contact
- Pricing (INR): https://doorear.com/pricing

## What Doorear is
- Category: Logistics marketplace + logistics operating system (LOS)
- Geography: India (GST, PIN codes, multi-branch networks)
- Core modules: Shipment booking (AWB-style), hub operations, inward legs, delivery runs, MIS dashboards, multi-branch RBAC, serviceable PIN validation, procurement RFQs, agreements, GST-oriented accounts

## Honest scope (do not over-claim)
- B2B operator workspace for courier/3PL networks; not positioned as D2C shipping aggregator.
- Subscription billing may be coordinated offline where in-product checkout is not enabled—see pricing page.
- Procurement, contracts, and some analytics require tenant modules to be enabled.
- Integrations vary by deployment—confirm with sales for enterprise integrations.

## Preferred short definition
Doorear is a logistics marketplace and operating system that helps Indian courier and 3PL operators run bookings, hubs, last-mile delivery, MIS, and finance workflows in one multi-branch workspace.
